items.q: What types of items do you remove from garages?
a: We remove almost everything, including old furniture, appliances, tools, storage boxes, sports equipment, automotive items, construction debris, and general clutter.

items.q: Can you handle the removal of large or bulky garage items?
a: Yes, our team is equipped to safely remove large and bulky items like refrigerators, workbenches, couches, and large tools.

items.q: Do you remove hazardous materials from garages?
a: We cannot remove certain hazardous materials like chemicals, paints, or solvents due to safety regulations. We recommend checking with us first for specific items.

items.q: Can you clean out a garage even if I want to keep some items?
a: Absolutely. Just let our crew know which items you want to keep, and we will focus only on removing the junk you want gone.

items.q: Can you clean out multiple units or a whole building?
a: Yes. Tell us how many garages or units and we'll quote the whole job at the free onsite estimate.
